observations: Photo 0 shows a green industrial hammer mill with two motors, a hopper, a conical collection bin, and a duct connecting them. A man stands beside it in a factory-like setting.
Photo 1 shows a similar green hammer mill, but with a yellow motor and a silver collection bin, placed outdoors in front of a metal shutter.
Photo 2 is a studio-style shot of a green hammer mill with a black motor, against a white background. The machine has a conical collection bin and a duct.
All three photos show the same general design: a central grinding chamber with a hopper on top, a motor on the side, and a duct leading to a conical collection bin.
No brand or model name is visible in any photo. The watermark 'LEAD DYAMOND CROWN' is present in all photos, but this is likely the seller's watermark, not the machine's brand.
The machines appear to be made of metal, with painted green frames and some stainless steel components (especially in photo 1).
There are no visible signs of damage or wear in the photos, but no close-ups of internal components or wear points are provided.
